evals.prompt: Plan content for our product launch month
evals.expected_output: A content calendar mapped to audience segments and channels, with pieces sequenced (teaser, launch, follow-up), owners, and measurable goals per channel.

evals.prompt: Our blog gets traffic but no conversions. Improve the content strategy
evals.expected_output: Maps existing content to funnel stages, finds the gap (top-of-funnel posts with no path to product), and adds conversion points such as relevant internal CTAs and mid-funnel content.
